description: Source code implementing CPU caching memory allocator for PyTorch, including functions for allocation, deallocation, and management of cached memory, as well as thread-local allocator handling.

classes.name: CPUCachingAllocator
classes.description: Class managing CPU memory caching for efficient allocation and deallocation.

classes.name: WithCPUCachingAllocatorGuard
classes.description: RAII guard class for setting and restoring thread-local CPU caching allocator.

methods.name: allocate_and_cache
methods.description: Allocates CPU memory and caches it, with error handling and retry logic.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates CPU memory, reusing cached blocks if available.

methods.name: free
methods.description: Frees CPU memory, either returning it to cache or freeing it directly.

methods.name: record_free
methods.description: Records external freeing of memory outside the allocator.

methods.name: free_cached
methods.description: Frees all cached memory back to the OS.
